method: Boundaries derived from the PRINTED PDF (title pages carrying the homage, and the book-end colophons), then matched to corpus ordinals by the opening verse text. The corpus `book` field was NOT used to set any boundary: it is a running header and lands LATE at every seam in this volume too (Therī-apadāna field first appears at ord 2077, real start 2072; Buddhavaṁsa at 3436, real start 3432). This is the same defect that made 19Khu02's recorded boundaries wrong.
page_offset_warning: The corpus `pdf_page` DRIFTS within 21Khu04 because blank separator pages between books are not counted (real p201 and p416 area). A single measured offset for the volume is therefore an approximation — drive page ranges from the PDF's own title pages and colophons, as here.
work: Apadānapāḷi — Therāpadāna, vaggas 1-42 (the work CONTINUES into 21Khu04)
note: ONE book span for the whole volume, but NOT a whole work. Therāpadāna's 56 vaggas run 1-42 here and 43-56 in 21Khu04; the edition closes it with 'Therāpadānaṁ samattaṁ.' on 21Khu04 real p200. Verse numbers `n` reset PER VAGGA, not per apadāna and not per book, so an n-reset is a VAGGA boundary here — do not reuse 19Khu02's n-reset rule for book boundaries in this volume.
